{{Top|leg}}
'''Comedians''' were [[entertainer]]s who used humor to entertain audiences in venues such as [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclubs]]. In [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] comedians often teamed up with [[Mrlssi]], and much of their humor derived from the differing sizes and masses of the two [[Species/Legends|species]]. Despite being generally successful, Herglic often found the jokes to be in poor taste, while the Mrlssi found them to be amusing.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
